name: Arbarion
bio: The Puregrove is old beyond reckoning, and is said to be where the Eldrin came to be – stepping straight from the trees like the dryads of old, taking on mortal flesh so they might know life’s joys and sorrows. Arbarion is a vestige from that long-forgotten age, and it guards the Puregrove still.
subtitle: The Verdant Heart

effects.label: Regeneration
effects.description: Heals the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the buff. The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This buff can be stacked.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.
